transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, occupational health sent me in. They're saying I'm not eating enough. I mean, most days I just keep it to black coffee... maybe a plain yogurt or a few bites of chicken at night. Honestly, sitting down for a full meal just feels like I'm letting my standards slip.
Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, even if others might see you as underweight?

Yeah, I do. Honestly, if the scale is up even half a pound, I get this jolt... like I've just completely lost control of things. And when that happens, I'll spend the rest of the day cutting back even harder. I just really can't stand the idea of putting any weight back on.
Do you ever make yourself sick, use laxatives, or exercise excessively after eating to control your weight?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything like that. And I don't really exercise like crazy either. I just... well, I just keep a really tight lid on what goes in to begin with. It's easier to just not eat than to try and undo it later.
Have you ever experienced any unusual thoughts or perceptions, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don’t, or having beliefs that people around you don’t share?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things, and I don't have any strange beliefs. My mind is clear. I just have my routine with food, but no, no unusual thoughts or anything like you're describing.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently, or do you consider your current weight to be well below what is healthy for your height and build?

Yeah, I have lost a significant amount. My uniform just hangs off me now, and I've had to tighten my belt way past the old notches. But as for considering it too low... I don't really see it that way. A nurse told me recently that my weight was dangerously low, but honestly, when she said that, my first thought was just that I could still stand to be a little sharper.
Have you missed any menstrual periods, or has your period stopped altogether?
Well, doc, I'm a man, so... no, I haven't missed any periods. That's not really something that applies to me.
